common.appTagline: Patient Health Records & Clinical Allergy Portal

home.heroSubtitle: A comprehensive clinical health portal designed for patients to securely log personal details, medical test reports, and doctor prescriptions. Backed by encrypted cloud storage in MongoDB Atlas.
home.heroPill: Doctor Prescriptions & Medical Lab Reports Management
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Simple 4-step workflow designed for patients, clinical researchers, and healthcare monitoring.
home.step1Desc: Register with your full name, DOB, address, and sex. Your age is automatically calculated from your birth date.
home.step2Desc: Log doctor prescriptions, allergen names, emergency auto-injectors (e.g. EpiPen), and documented reactions.
home.step3Desc: Input Skin Prick Tests (mm wheal) and Blood IgE results (kUA/L) directly from clinical lab reports or Intelligent OCR.
home.step4Desc: All records are validated and securely saved in MongoDB Atlas. Access, update, or delete your data anytime.

assistant.tooltip: Hello! I am your visual health guide. Click me for a guided tour or contextual help!
assistant.tutorialIntro: Hi! Welcome to your personal health dashboard. I will guide you through the key features step-by-step.
assistant.step1Desc: First, review or complete your health profile. Your age is calculated dynamically from your date of birth.
assistant.step2Desc: Here you can record doctor-confirmed food allergies so our system can detect unsafe ingredients in your meals.
assistant.step3Desc: Upload your lab test reports (PDF or images). Our Intelligent OCR will read the report and extract test values for you.
assistant.step4Desc: Review Specific IgE and Skin Prick Test results. We strictly separate raw sensitization from doctor-confirmed clinical allergies.
assistant.step5Desc: Log what you eat every day. If a meal contains an ingredient you are allergic to, you will see a real-time safety alert.
assistant.step6Desc: Whenever you experience adverse symptoms, record them here. Signs of severe anaphylaxis trigger immediate emergency triage.
assistant.step7Desc: Generate a comprehensive clinical AI report synthesizing your meals, symptoms, and lab tests following AAAAI/EAACI guidelines.
assistant.step8Desc: Discover statistical patterns and repeated associations between foods eaten and symptoms experienced over time.

assistant.contextHistory: Inspect statistical correlations for foods consumed within 4 hours prior to symptoms.

footer.disclaimerText: This application is designed to securely store and organize personal medical test records and prescription data from certified physicians. The system strictly distinguishes between recorded diagnostic test results and confirmed clinical diagnoses, and does not provide automated self-diagnosis. Always consult a qualified board-certified allergist or immunologist for formal medical decisions.
